newsitem.title: USA: TAG Heuer 1996 sales rise 10.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: TAG Heuer 1996 sales rise 10.6 pct.

text.p: Swiss watch maker Tag Heuer International SA said on Monday that it 1996 sales increased 10.6 percent to 419.7 million Swiss francs from 379.6 million swiss francs in 1995.
Audited results will be available in the first week of April, the company said.

TAG Heuer said it also agreed to acquire its distributor in the United Kingdom, Duval. Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed, but the acquisition will be funded from internal resources and is expected to have a positive effect on earnings.
The company said its board approved an employee stock program to align the interests of key executives with those of the company's shareholders.
The intial program will cost approximately four million swiss francs and the cost will be spread over three years, the company said.
